A '''double-bladed stiletto''' was a weapon that contained two long, thin blades attached to a wrist sheathe, so the twin blades extended over the back of the hand. The blades could be retracted into the wrist sheathe and concealed under long sleeves, then extended with a flick of the forearm. A [[miner]] named [[Jake (miner)|Jake]] attacked [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] with two double-bladed stilettos and [[double-bladed boot]]s on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the original novel of ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'' Jake's double-bladed stilettos were concealed under his sleeves. This was because deadly weapons were illegal in the five [[mine towns]], and any such weapons would need to be concealed. However in the [[Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1|comic adaptation]] Jake wears an outfit with the sleeves ripped off, and the wrist sheathes for his double-bladed stilettos can be clearly seen.
